1161: then God comes and resolves one's affairs. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ. ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
why do you not remember the Lord, the Destroyer of pain? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਸਿੰਘੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
As long as the tiger lives in the forest,
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਆਰੁ; ਸਿੰਘ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
But when the jackal eats the tiger,
The one who thinks he has won is drowned; the one who is humbled swims across;
by the Guru's grace one crosses over.
remain lovingly attuned to the Lord alone. ॥3॥6॥14॥
ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
He has seven thousand commanders, you say,
and hundreds of thousands of prophets;
eighty-eight crores of shaikhs are said to be His,
ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
Who will carry the plea of a poor man like me to Him?
ਮਜਲਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ; ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
His court is far away; who can reach His mansion? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He has thirty-three crores of servants,
and the beings of the 8.4 million species wander insane.
ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦਮ ਕਉ; ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
He showed but a little stern glance to Father Adam,
and Adam too had paradise only a little while. ॥2॥
ਦਿਲ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
One whose heart is in turmoil turns pale in the face;
he forsakes his scripture and does the devil's work.
He blames the world and is angry with people,
yet he receives what he himself has done. ॥3॥
You are the Giver; I am ever a beggar.
If I were to refuse Your gifts, I would be a sinner.
Servant Kabir has entered Your shelter;
keep me near You, O Merciful Lord — that is paradise for me. ॥4॥7॥15॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ; ਊਹਾਂ ॥
ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ; ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but I do not know where heaven is. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪ ਆਪ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
One who does not know the mystery of his own self
speaks of heaven only in words. ॥1॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
As long as the mind hopes for heaven,
one does not dwell at the Lord's feet. ॥2॥
Heaven is not a fort with moats, ramparts and walls;
I do not know what heaven's gate is like. ॥3॥
Says Kabir, now what more can I say?
The company of the holy is heaven itself. ॥4॥8॥16॥
How can the impregnable fortress be taken, O brother?
ਦੋਵਰ ਕੋਟ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਵਰ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It has double walls and a triple moat. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਾਂਚ ਪਚੀਸ, ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ; ਆਡੀ. ਪਰਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
It is defended by the five, the twenty-five, attachment, pride and jealousy, and the mighty power of Maya.
ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ; ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
The poor mortal has no strength to conquer it; what shall I do, O Lord? ॥1॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕਿਵਾਰੀ. ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ; ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
Lust is the keeper of the gate; pain and pleasure are the gatekeepers; vice and virtue are the doors.
ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ. ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ; ਤਹ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
Anger is the chief, full of argument and strife, and the mind is the rebel king there. ॥2॥
ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ. ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੋ; ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਚਢਾਈ ॥
His armour is the pleasure of taste, his helmet is possessiveness, and his bow is evil intellect.
ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤੀਰ. ਰਹੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਇਉ ਗਢੁ ਲੀਓ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
The arrows of craving are within the heart; so the fortress cannot be taken. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਲੀਤਾ. ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਵਾਈ; ਗੋਲਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
But I made divine love the fuse and deep meditation the rocket, and fired the cannonball of spiritual wisdom.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ, ਸਹਜੇ ਪਰਜਾਲੀ; ਏਕਹਿ ਚੋਟ ਸਿਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
The fire of God was lit with poise, and with one shot the fortress was taken. ॥4॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਲੈ. ਲਰਨੇ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤੋਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
Taking truth and contentment, I began to fight and stormed both gates.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਪਕਰਿਓ ਗਢ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੫॥
In the company of the holy and by the Guru's grace, I captured the king of the fortress. ॥5॥
1162: ਭਗਵਤ ਭੀਰਿ. ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ; ਕਟੀ ਕਾਲ ਭੈ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
With the army of the Lord's devotees and the power of meditation, I have cut the noose of the fear of death.
ਦਾਸੁ ਕਮੀਰੁ. ਚੜੑਿਓ ਗੜੑ ਊਪਰਿ; ਰਾਜੁ ਲੀਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੬॥੯॥੧੭॥
Servant Kabir has climbed to the top of the fortress and obtained the eternal kingdom. ॥6॥9॥17॥
Into mother Ganges, deep and profound,
they threw Kabir, bound in chains. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਡਿਗੈ; ਤਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਾਇ ॥
My mind was not shaken; why should my body be afraid?
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My awareness remained absorbed in the lotus feet of the Lord. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੰਗਾ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ; ਮੇਰੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
The waves of the Ganges broke my chains,
and Kabir sat as if on a deerskin. ॥2॥
ਕਹਿ ਕੰਬੀਰ; ਕੋਊ. ਸੰਗ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
Says Kabir, I have no friend or companion;
on water and on land, the Lord is my protector. ॥3॥10॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
In an inaccessible, impregnable fortress He has made His dwelling,
where His divine light shines forth.
Lightning flashes there, and there is bliss,
where the eternal young Lord of the universe abides. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
When this soul is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name,
ਜਰਾ ਮਰਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
old age and death are gone, and doubt runs away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਿਉ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Those whose minds love distinctions of high and low caste
The unstruck melody resounds and vibrates there,
where the supreme Lord God abides. ॥2॥
He creates continents, realms and solar systems;
He destroys the three worlds, the three qualities and the three gods.
The inaccessible, unfathomable Lord God dwells in the heart;
ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
no one can find the limits or secrets of the Support of the earth. ॥3॥
As fragrance radiates from the plantain flower,
and pollen dwells in the lotus,
so the mantra of the Lord dwells within the twelve-petalled lotus of the heart,
where the Lord of Lakshmi abides. ॥4॥
Below, above, and in every direction His light shines;
in the realm of deep stillness He makes His light manifest.
There is no sun or moon there;
the primal, immaculate Lord celebrates there. ॥5॥
Know that He who is in the universe is also in the body;
take your cleansing bath in the sacred lake of the mind.
ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਪ ॥
One who chants "He and I are one"
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਲਿਪਤ. ਨ ਹੋਇ; ਪੁੰਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਪ ॥੬॥
is not affected by virtue or vice. ॥6॥
He is not affected by high or low caste, by sunshine or shade;
ਅਵਰ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
this state is not found anywhere but in the sanctuary of the Guru.
ਟਾਰੀ. ਨ ਟਰੈ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
It is not removed by removing; it does not come or go;
one remains absorbed in the deep stillness of poise. ॥7॥
One who knows the Lord within the mind —
whatever he speaks, he becomes one with Him.
One who firmly implants the divine light and mantra within the mind —
says Kabir, that mortal crosses over. ॥8॥1॥
Millions of suns shine for Him;
millions of Shivas and Kailash mountains;
ਦੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
millions of Durgas massage His feet;
millions of Brahmas chant the Vedas for Him. ॥1॥
When I beg, I beg only from the Lord;
ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have nothing to do with any other deity. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Millions of moons shine as His lamps;
1163: the thirty-three crores of gods eat His offerings;
millions of the nine planets stand in His court;
millions of Righteous Judges are His gatekeepers. ॥2॥
Millions of winds blow around His pavilion;
millions of serpents prepare His bed;
millions of oceans are His water-carriers;
the eighteen loads of vegetation, millions of them, are like the hairs of His body. ॥3॥
Millions of treasurers fill His treasury;
millions of Lakshmis adorn themselves for Him;
millions of vices and virtues look to Him;
ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥੪॥
Fifty-six crores of clouds are His gatekeepers;
in every land they flash endlessly;
millions of goddesses with dishevelled hair move about in fearsome forms;
the Lord of the world plays in millions of ways. ॥5॥
Millions of sacrificial feasts are held in His court;
millions of celestial singers proclaim His victory;
millions of sciences all sing His praises;
ਤਊ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥੬॥
yet even so, the limits of the transcendent Lord cannot be found. ॥6॥
Millions of Vamans are like the hairs of His body;
millions of Rams, by whom Ravan's army was defeated;
millions of Krishnas, of whom the Puranas speak at length,
who crushed the pride of Duryodhan. ॥7॥
ਕੰਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੋਟਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ. ਨ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
Millions of gods of love cannot compete with Him,
who steal the desires from deep within hearts.
Says Kabir, listen, O Lord of the world:
I beg for the gift of the fearless state. ॥8॥2॥18॥20॥
ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O tongue, I would cut you into a hundred pieces
if you did not chant the Name of the Lord of the universe. ॥1॥
ਰੰਗੀ ਲੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Dye your tongue with the Lord's Name;
ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
meditating on the Lord, Har Har, dye it a beautiful colour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
False are the other occupations of the tongue;
ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ; ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
the state of freedom from desire comes only through the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
Even if I performed countless millions of other worships,
they would not equal even one Name of the Lord. ॥3॥
Prays Namdev, this is my occupation:
One who stays away from others' wealth and others' wives —
the Lord dwells near that person. ॥1॥
Those who do not meditate on the Lord —
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੈ; ਨ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I do not even want to see them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those whose inner beings are separated from the Lord
Prays Namdev, a man without a nose
does not look handsome, even with the thirty-two marks of beauty. ॥3॥2॥
Filling a bowl with milk and a jug with water,
Namdev milked the brown cow and brought it. ॥1॥
Drink this milk, O Lord of the universe;
drink this milk, and my mind will be at ease;
ਨਾਹੀ ਤ; ਘਰ ਕੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
otherwise my father at home will be angry. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Taking the golden cup filled with nectar,
Namdev placed it before the Lord. ॥2॥
"This one devotee dwells in My heart" —
the Lord looked upon Namdev and smiled. ॥3॥
The Lord drank the milk, and the devotee returned home;
1164: thus Namdev came to see the Lord. ॥4॥3॥
I am crazy — the Lord is my Husband;
ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਕਰਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
I decorate and adorn myself for Him. ॥1॥
ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ. ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ; ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
Slander me well, slander me well, slander me well, O people;
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ; ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
my body and mind belong to my Beloved Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ; ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Do not engage in any argument or debate with anyone;
with your tongue drink in the Lord's sublime essence. ॥2॥
ਅਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਿ; ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Now I know within my soul that such an arrangement has been made:
I meet my Lord with the beat of the drum. ॥3॥
Anyone may praise or slander me;
Namdev has met the Lord of Lakshmi. ॥4॥4॥
ਕਬਹੂ; ਖੀਰਿ ਖਾਡ ਘੀਉ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Sometimes one does not appreciate rice pudding, sugar and ghee;
sometimes one must beg for crusts of bread from door to door;
sometimes one picks out grains of gram from the rubbish. ॥1॥
ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
As the Lord keeps us, so we live, O brother;
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Lord's glory cannot be described. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Sometimes one prances about on fine horses;
sometimes one does not even have shoes for the feet. ॥2॥
Sometimes one sleeps on a cosy bed with white sheets;
sometimes one does not even have straw to lie on the ground. ॥3॥
Prays Namdev, only the Name saves us;
ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
one who meets the Guru is carried across. ॥4॥5॥
Laughing and playing, I came to Your temple, O Lord;
while Namdev was worshipping, he was grabbed and driven out. ॥1॥
I am of a low social class, O Lord;
ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਜਨਮਿ; ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
why was I born into a family of calico printers? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I picked up my blanket and went back,
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
As Namdev uttered the praises of the Lord,
the temple turned around to face the Lord's humble devotee. ॥3॥6॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
As the hungry person loves food,
and the thirsty person is concerned with water,
and as the fool is attached to his family —
just so, Namdev loves the Lord. ॥1॥
Namdev is in love with the Lord;
he has naturally and intuitively become detached from the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As the woman who falls in love with another man,
and the greedy man who loves only wealth,
and the lustful man who loves women —
just so, Namdev loves the Lord. ॥2॥
That alone is true love which the Lord Himself instils;
by the Guru's grace, duality is dispelled.
Such love never breaks; one remains absorbed in Him;
Namdev has focused his awareness on the True Name. ॥3॥
Like the love between the child and its mother,
so is my mind imbued with the Lord.
Prays Namdev, I am in love with the Lord;
the Lord of the universe dwells within my awareness. ॥4॥1॥7॥
The blind fool abandons the wife of his own home,
1165: and has an affair with another woman.
He is like the parrot who is pleased to see the simmal tree;
but at the end he dies, stuck to it. ॥1॥
The home of the sinner is on fire;
ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ; ਮਿਟਵੈ ਕਬ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
it keeps burning and the fire cannot be put out. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
He does not go to see where the Lord is worshipped;
he abandons the right path and takes the wrong one;
forgetting the Primal Lord, he comes and goes in reincarnation;
he throws away the nectar and gathers poison to eat. ॥2॥
Like the prostitute who comes to dance,
wearing beautiful clothes and decorated with ornaments,
she dances to the beat, carefully watching her breath —
ਵਾ ਕੇ ਗਲੇ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਫਾਸ ॥੩॥
the noose of the Messenger of Death is around her neck. ॥3॥
One who has grace inscribed on his forehead
ਸੋ ਭਜਿ; ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
hurries to enter the Guru's sanctuary.
in this way, O saints, cross over. ॥4॥2॥8॥
ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ; ਹਮ ਹੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Sanda and Marka went to complain to the king: "Prahlad will not study; we have tried and failed.
ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹੈ. ਕਰ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ; ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
He chants the Lord's Name, clapping his hands; he has spoiled all the other students." ॥1॥
He keeps chanting the Lord's Name;
ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he enshrines remembrance of the dear Lord within his heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਜੇ; ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ॥
His mother, the queen, pleaded with him: "Your father the king has conquered the whole earth."
ਪੂਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਤਉ ਅਉਰੈ ਠਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
But Prahlad the son would not obey; he had resolved upon something else. ॥2॥
ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ, ਮੰਤਰ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਕਰਸਹ ਅਉਧ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥

without the Guru, the saintly Lord does not grant His company;
without the Guru, the blind weep in worldly entanglements;
ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਲੁ. ਸਬਦਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
the mind of the Guru-facing is pure; the Word washes away its filth. ॥3॥
Uniting with the Lord, the Guru has subdued the mind;
day and night one enjoys the union of devotion.
ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
In the gathering of the Guru and saints, pain and disease are erased;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
servant Nanak, the Lord, the Husband, is united in poise. ॥4॥6॥
He Himself fashions and creates His creation;
the True Lord Himself administers justice, ruling His kingdom.
Through the sublime teaching of the Guru, He is ever one's companion;
the Lord's Name is the elixir, and the wealth of poise. ॥1॥
ਮਤ ਬਿਸਰਸਿ; ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
O mind, do not forget; chant the Lord's Name.
ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ. ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The infinite, inaccessible, unfathomable Lord is weighed by the Guru-facing; the Lord Himself makes the unweighable weighed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Gursikhs who serve the Guru's feet become Yours, O Lord;
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਤਰੇ; ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰ ਤੋਰ ॥
serving the Guru, they are carried across, forsaking "mine" and "yours."
Slanderous and greedy people are hard-hearted;
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਭਾਈ; ਸਿ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
they do not love to serve the Guru; they are the worst of thieves. ॥2॥
When the Guru is pleased, He blesses one with loving devotion;
ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
when the Guru is pleased, one obtains a place in the Lord's mansion.
Abandon slander, and awaken in devotion to the Lord;
devotion to the Lord is beautiful; it comes by His grace and destiny. ॥3॥
The Guru unites one in union and grants His gift;
the Gursikhs are loved day and night.
ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
They obtain the fruit of the Name when the Guru is pleased and gives it;
says Nanak, rare are those who obtain it. ॥4॥7॥
When it pleases the Master, His servant serves Him;
he remains dead while yet alive, and saves all his generations. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ॥
I shall not give up devotion to You, O Lord; what does it matter if people laugh at me?
ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Name dwells within my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
As a mortal remains engrossed in attachment to Maya,
ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਤ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
so the Lord's humble saint remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਊਪਰਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ॥
I am foolish and ignorant; be merciful to me,
that I may remain in Your sanctuary. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Says Nanak, worldly affairs are fruitless;
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
only by the Guru's grace does one obtain the nectar of the Name. ॥4॥8॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਬਿਪ ਪੂਜਿ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ; ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
O Brahmin, worship and propitiate the Lord as your salagram stone, and make good deeds your rosary of tulsi beads.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ; ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
Build the boat by chanting the Lord's Name, and pray, "O Merciful Lord, be merciful to me." ॥1॥
